_README: TEMPLATE ONLY — NOT EVIDENCE. This file does not close the soak gate. The real artifact is docs/evidence/pkce-devx-verification-<UTC-timestamp>.json, written by the human who performs the single real login (step 1.6 item 5). Every 'passed' below is null because no login has happened. Do not rename this file to a timestamped name without actually running the flow and filling in real values.

checks.name: authorization_redirect
checks.detail: Record the full /oauth2/authorize URL. Assert response_type=code, code_challenge_method=S256, and redirect_uri exactly https://db-redesign.d3j2wnm8g5clnw.amplifyapp.com/callback.
checks.expected: 302 to the hosted UI login page

checks.name: callback_route
checks.detail: Record the /callback URL Cognito returns to. Assert the returned state matches the value stored in sessionStorage under careervp.pkce.state, and that a code parameter is present.
checks.expected: 200 from the SPA /callback route, state round-trips

checks.name: token_exchange
checks.detail: Record the POST to /oauth2/token. Assert code_verifier is sent, no client_secret is sent (public client), and id/access/refresh tokens come back. Record the token 'iss' claim and assert it names us-east-1_bAZ6jb6HP, NOT us-east-1_WiHMRqLpe — that assertion is the whole point of the fallback removal.

checks.name: authenticated_api_call
checks.detail: One authenticated GET against the devx raw execute-api URL. Record the request id.

checks.name: forced_401
checks.detail: Force a 401 (e.g. tamper the access token) and record it.

checks.name: refresh_exactly_once
checks.detail: Count refresh attempts triggered by the 401. This is the §3 item-10 frontend contract: EXACTLY ONE refresh. Two or more is a FAILURE, not a retry — record the observed count explicitly.
checks.expected: refresh_count == 1, then the original request succeeds

checks.name: sign_out
checks.detail: Record the /logout URL. Assert logout_uri is exactly https://db-redesign.d3j2wnm8g5clnw.amplifyapp.com/ and that the session is cleared.
checks.expected: 302 back to the registered logout URL, session gone
